pretreatment: Argon sputtering followed by 20 min annealing
evidence: The trapezoidal Si(100) sample with 45° beveled edges (Harrick Scientific) was mounted on a manipulator, where cooling and heating was possible in the range of 90 -1150 K. The surface was cleaned by cycles of argon (Matheson, 99.999%) sputtering followed by 20 min annealing until the cleanness and order of the surface were confirmed spectroscopically.
